messages.subject: Nazih | GCC Energy & Natural Resources Executive Profile | Government Relations & ESG
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Saade,

I am sharing my profile for senior GCC leadership mandates across mining, energy, natural resources, industrials and government-facing corporate functions.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, compliance coordination and executive communications for a major gold-mining operation.

Human Valoris' retained executive-search presence across Saudi Arabia and the UAE, together with its Energy & Natural Resources specialization and Agilium Worldwide platform, aligns closely with the direction of my next move.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head, Country Director and VP-track mandates across External Affairs, Government Relations, Corporate Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Social Performance and Country Leadership. Saudi Arabia is my first GCC priority, followed by the UAE.

I have attached a GCC-focused executive CV for confidential consideration. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
